# SwiftPieces

> SwiftPieces (swiftpieces.com) is a free library of 69 SwiftUI components for iOS in 14 categories: animated, gesture-driven interactions such as a swipeable card stack, Liquid Glass (iOS 26) menus, a floating tab bar, interactive charts, form inputs and AI chat surfaces. Each piece is one self-contained Swift file (plus a .metal file where a shader is involved) on Apple frameworks only, from iOS 17. Install by copy-paste, `npx swiftpieces add <Name>`, or the SwiftPieces MCP server.

Key facts:

- License: MIT + Commons Clause. Free for personal and commercial apps, including client work. Source-available rather than OSI open source: the pieces themselves may not be sold or redistributed.
- No dependencies and no Swift package: the CLI copies source files into a SwiftPieces folder in the app, and they become the developer's own code.
- iOS 17 baseline. Liquid Glass pieces gate glass with `#available(iOS 26, *)` and fall back to Material.
- One motion language across every piece: five spring tiers with named roles, gesture releases that keep the finger's velocity, rubber-band limits and a Reduce Motion substitute for every movement (https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-motion).
- States and accessibility are built in (Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, Reduce Transparency), with haptics (sensoryFeedback) where an interaction calls for them.
- Source: https://github.com/Saivion/SwiftPieces

Rules for Liquid Glass: gate with `#available(iOS 26, *)` and a Material fallback; wrap multiple glass views in one `GlassEffectContainer`; apply `.glassEffect` after layout modifiers; respect `accessibilityReduceTransparency`; never use invented modifiers such as `.liquidGlassUltra`.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/introduction)
- [Installation](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/installation)
- [CLI](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/cli)
- [MCP and agents](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/mcp)

- [Registry index (JSON)](https://swiftpieces.com/r/index.json)
- [Free MCP endpoint](https://swiftpieces.com/api/mcp): search_pieces, get_piece, install_piece, list_categories, get_liquid_glass_guide
- [Full text for LLMs](https://swiftpieces.com/llms-full.txt): every piece's notes and parameters, and every guide

## Tools

- [App Library](https://swiftpieces.com/apps): App Store apps remixed as original SwiftUI screens to try, take apart and remix in the browser Playground. Three are free; the rest come with Pro.
- [Styles](https://swiftpieces.com/styles): make one style for every screen (accent, light and dark, iOS fonts, corners, cards, buttons, spacing, motion) on live SwiftUI components. A style travels as a short code (SP2-…) that the Playground's Style tab and its `?style=` links read, and exports as Theme.swift.

## Guides

- [SwiftUI Animations: A Practical Guide with Examples](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-animations): SwiftUI animations explained with working examples: implicit and explicit animation, spring animation, transitions, keyframe animators, and gestures.
- [SwiftUI Motion: Springs, Rubber Banding and Gesture Momentum](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-motion): How to make SwiftUI motion feel physical: spring tiers, finger tracking without lag, velocity that carries into the release, rubber banding, press deformation, squash and stretch, follow-through and Reduce Motion.
- [SwiftUI Buttons: Custom Styles, Animation, Loading](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-buttons): SwiftUI buttons from the basics to custom ButtonStyle, press animation, haptics, async loading states, hold to confirm, and accessible hit targets.
- [SwiftUI Cards: Card Views, Swipe Stacks and Flip Cards](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-cards): Build SwiftUI cards that feel native: continuous corners, layered shadows, press states, a swipeable card stack, a 3D flip card, tilt and scroll parallax.
- [SwiftUI Haptics: sensoryFeedback and Haptic Feedback](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-haptics): A practical guide to SwiftUI haptics: sensoryFeedback triggers, conditions and feedback kinds, drag threshold ticks, UIKit generators, and restraint.
- [SwiftUI Skeleton Loading, Shimmer and Loading States](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-loading-states): SwiftUI skeleton loading with redacted placeholders, a shimmer modifier, ProgressView styles, success and failure morphs, paging footers and Reduce Motion.

## Collections

- [SwiftUI text effects](https://swiftpieces.com/components/text): Free SwiftUI text effects for iOS: animated text reveal with highlights, Liquid Glass text and expandable Read more text. One Swift file each, no dependencies. (4 pieces)
- [SwiftUI animated backgrounds](https://swiftpieces.com/components/backgrounds): Free animated SwiftUI backgrounds for iOS: a Metal shader silk surface with device-tilt lighting and an interactive Canvas dot grid with haptics. (2 pieces)
- [SwiftUI Liquid Glass components](https://swiftpieces.com/components/glass): Free SwiftUI Liquid Glass components for iOS 26: glass surface, segmented control and floating action menu, each with a Material fallback for iOS 17. (5 pieces)
- [SwiftUI buttons and controls](https://swiftpieces.com/components/controls): Free custom SwiftUI buttons and controls for iOS: animated button styles, an async loading button, hold to confirm, a timer dial and more. With haptics. (5 pieces)
- [SwiftUI input fields and form controls](https://swiftpieces.com/components/inputs): Free SwiftUI inputs for iOS: floating label text field, password strength field, currency field, token field, date range picker, range slider and map location picker. (12 pieces)
- [SwiftUI cards](https://swiftpieces.com/components/cards): Free SwiftUI card components for iOS: a swipeable card stack, 3D flip card, device-tilt motion card and parallax image card. One file each, with haptics. (4 pieces)
- [SwiftUI lists and carousels](https://swiftpieces.com/components/lists): Free SwiftUI list components for iOS: custom swipe action rows, a swipeable task row, status timeline, depth paging carousel and an infinite scroll list. (7 pieces)
- [SwiftUI navigation components](https://swiftpieces.com/components/navigation): Free SwiftUI navigation components for iOS: a floating tab bar dock, paging tabs with a scroll-tracking indicator and a stretchy header that pins to the nav bar. (4 pieces)
- [SwiftUI sheets and toasts](https://swiftpieces.com/components/sheets): Free SwiftUI sheet components for iOS: a confirmation bottom sheet, a pre-permission sheet, a toast with undo and a spotlight coach mark tour. Haptics included. (4 pieces)
- [SwiftUI feedback and loading states](https://swiftpieces.com/components/feedback): Free SwiftUI feedback components for iOS: skeleton loading with shimmer, loading to success checkmark animation, success and error screens, like button, star rating. (5 pieces)
- [SwiftUI gesture and motion modifiers](https://swiftpieces.com/components/motion): Free SwiftUI motion modifiers for iOS: drag to dismiss for photos, cards and sheets, with velocity-based springs, a styled scrim, haptics and Reduce Motion. (1 pieces)
- [SwiftUI charts and data components](https://swiftpieces.com/components/data): Free SwiftUI data components for iOS: an interactive line and bar chart, scrubbable donut chart, streak heatmap calendar, rolling odometer and KPI stat tiles. (5 pieces)
- [SwiftUI AI chat components](https://swiftpieces.com/components/ai): Free SwiftUI AI chat components for iOS: streaming text reply, thinking indicator, prompt suggestion chips, answer sources and citations, and Metal shader orbs. (6 pieces)
- [SwiftUI photo and media components](https://swiftpieces.com/components/media): Free SwiftUI media components for iOS: a full-screen photo viewer with pinch to zoom and drag to dismiss, a photo cropper and a Stories progress bar. (5 pieces)
- [SwiftUI animations](https://swiftpieces.com/components/animations): Free animated SwiftUI components for iOS: card stacks, 3D flips, text reveals, rolling numbers, loading morphs and spring buttons. One Swift file each. (16 pieces)
- [SwiftUI components with haptic feedback](https://swiftpieces.com/components/haptics): Free SwiftUI components with haptic feedback built in: buttons, sliders, dials, ratings, sheets and gestures that tick, tap and confirm with sensoryFeedback. (20 pieces)

## SwiftPieces Pro

A separate paid library for building whole apps: 54 screens, 48 flows, 12 app templates and a 31-item Build Kit (production-ready SwiftUI screens, flows that string them into whole journeys from first run to settings, complete Xcode projects, and agent skills that build the rest in the same design) at https://pro.swiftpieces.com/library, plus Pro remixing in the Playground at https://swiftpieces.com/apps (all 20 apps in the App Library, remix any app with AI, keep up to 100 remixes). One plan with lifetime access; plan and pricing: https://pro.swiftpieces.com/pro. Pro MCP endpoint: https://pro.swiftpieces.com/api/mcp (license key required): search_library, get_item, list_kit, get_kit_item, apply_design_skill, apply_recipe.

## AI (https://swiftpieces.com/components/ai)

- [Assistant Orb](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/ai/assistant-orb): A dark glass ball with a Siri-style voice wave inside, locked to the thinking state; four thin sine membranes travel through the equator of a refracting shell, drawn by a Metal color shader. The sphere never moves, only the wave, and a palette change crossfades its colours. (iOS 17.0+, Metal). Install: `npx swiftpieces add AssistantOrb`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/AssistantOrb.json
- [Prompt Chips](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/ai/prompt-chips): Liquid glass prompt chips above a composer, in a snapping horizontal row or a grid of columns, each keyed by a tinted glyph disc. They cascade in one after another as they appear. A tap presses the chip and swells it with a pop of its disc, and the other chips flow into it, nearest first, melting into its glass; then the gathered chip condenses into a drop that falls into the composer as the chips close, handing it the text. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add PromptChips`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/PromptChips.json
- [Source Stack](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/ai/source-stack): Citations for an AI answer: a compact pill of overlapping site badges and a source count that opens into a list of numbered source cards. The badges fly out of the stack into their cards as the list cascades in under them, each card opens its link with a press, and closing gathers the badges back into the pill. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add SourceStack`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/SourceStack.json
- [Streaming Reply](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/ai/streaming-reply): The AI reply surface in liquid glass. A glass header pill carries the assistant mark and a phase label that morphs letter by letter, text arrives token by token with a per-word fade and a tinted cursor bubble, inline code sits on neutral chips, and user prompts are signal-tinted glass bubbles. A long press lifts the message: the header pill swells into a glass card around the reply and Copy and Regenerate bud out of its bottom edge, and a stopped reply buds a signal Retry out of its header pill. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add StreamingReply`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/StreamingReply.json
- [Thinking State](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/ai/thinking-state): The "assistant is working" placeholder, laid out like the reply it becomes: a liquid glass header pill carrying a breathing mark and an elapsed-seconds label that morphs as it counts, over three presentations on one clock: block-colored rising dots, a sheen over reply-shaped bars, or a label whose glyphs carry the sheen. Plus a modifier that sweeps any view. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ThinkingState`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ThinkingState.json
- [Thought Orb](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/ai/thought-orb): A small dark glass ball with a Siri-style voice wave inside, locked to the thinking state and drawn by a Metal color shader; palettes for searching, reading and writing crossfade the colour with the kind of work. Its Pill is the status control in liquid glass: the mark rides a round glass bubble joined by a liquid neck to a capsule whose label morphs letter by letter into each new verb while the capsule reshapes around it, with indeterminate dots at its end. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass, Metal). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ThoughtOrb`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ThoughtOrb.json

## Backgrounds (https://swiftpieces.com/components/backgrounds)

- [Silk](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/backgrounds/silk): A slowly folding silk surface lit by a movable light and shaded from a real gradient normal in a Metal shader, in house block fabrics (the brand red among them) and an adaptive standard style, with optional device-tilt lighting. Content only, so it carries no glass. (iOS 17.0+, Metal). Install: `npx swiftpieces add Silk`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/Silk.json
- [Touch Grid](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/backgrounds/touch-grid): A Canvas dot grid that swells and warms into the brand red or another house block under the finger, springs back on release, and sends one dissipating ripple out from a tap. Content only, so it carries no glass. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add TouchGrid`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/TouchGrid.json

## Cards (https://swiftpieces.com/components/cards)

- [Flip Card](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/cards/flip-card): A two-sided card you flip by tap or by dragging sideways. The drag scrubs the rotation, release commits or snaps back by velocity and carries the flick into the landing, the card lifts toward you mid-turn with a layered shadow that slides off the raised edge, and each face shades as it turns edge-on. An optional liquid glass flip hint rides the card's axis, its signal dot smearing from the front slot to the back slot as the card turns, and the faces take semibold type. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add FlipCard`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/FlipCard.json
- [Motion Card](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/cards/motion-card): A solid color card that tilts with the device's attitude through an exponential filter, easing into its limit and leveling out when the grip changes, with a fixed-light sheen and a layered shadow that slide as it turns. Its content takes semibold type, and liquid glass chips laid on its face tilt and catch the same light. Press settles it toward flat, tips it down under the finger and sinks it with a light impact, and Core Motion stops whenever the scene is not active. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add MotionCard`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/MotionCard.json
- [Parallax Card](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/cards/parallax-card): An image card whose picture drifts slower than the scroll while a liquid glass caption panel drifts slower still, so the card reads in layers. The trailing glyph is a glass bubble joined to the panel by a liquid neck; a press lifts the card with a deeper shadow and the bubble leans toward its arrow, thinning the neck. The caption is composed from eyebrow, title, metadata, and trailing glyph slots. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ParallaxCard`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ParallaxCard.json
- [Swipe Deck](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/cards/swipe-deck): A gesture-driven card stack: the top card follows the finger and swings from where you grabbed it, a tinted liquid glass outcome badge buds in through the card's edge, leaning in from the side you head toward, and stamps at the threshold, melting back out if you return, the cards beneath rise one after another as it leaves, and release past the threshold or a flick throws it left, right, or up at the speed of your finger. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add SwipeDeck`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/SwipeDeck.json

## Controls (https://swiftpieces.com/components/controls)

- [Commit Button](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/controls/commit-button): A liquid glass async action button driven by one idle/loading/success/error/disabled phase: the signal glass capsule draws in around its label as a glass bubble buds out of its end carrying a spinning ring; on success the ring closes on a check and both turn sage, then the bubble melts home as the label morphs to its success title; an error morphs the label to the message on butter glass, turns the bubble into a retry and shakes. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add CommitButton`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/CommitButton.json
- [Elastic Button](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/controls/elastic-button): A ButtonStyle that squashes toward the touch point, stretches along the drag with rubber-band resistance, deepens after a hold and springs back with as much give as the pull put in. Optional liquid glass surfaces (signal, block and clear raised glass) float on a soft lift that flattens under the finger, and the glass darkens as it is pressed. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ElasticButton`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ElasticButton.json
- [Fan Stack](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/controls/fan-stack): Overlapping avatars in liquid glass bubbles that melt into one shape where they overlap, then fan apart on tap or hold through necks that stretch and snap, the hidden faces budding out of the +N bubble as it melts into them. A drag scrubs across them: the avatar under the finger lifts with its neighbours rolling up after it, a glass name tag buds out of it and a haptic ticks, and releasing selects it. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add FanStack`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/FanStack.json
- [Hold To Confirm](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/controls/hold-to-confirm): A press-and-hold liquid glass capsule for destructive or important actions: the signal tint wells out of the leading puck while held and sweeps through the glass, passing three milestone dots with rising haptics and inverting the label under it, drains back into the puck on an early release, and on completion turns sage, morphs its label and buds a sage check bubble out of its end. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add HoldToConfirm`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/HoldToConfirm.json
- [Timer Dial](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/controls/timer-dial): A countdown ring you set by dragging a liquid glass knob around it like the Timer dial, with a tick per step and a heavier detent every 5s. A solid ring over a minute-tick scale, semibold display numerals, a breathing signal warning zone, a sage finish, optional glass start, pause and reset bubbles that bud out of each other, and a determinate progress mode. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add TimerDial`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/TimerDial.json

## Data (https://swiftpieces.com/components/data)

- [Activity Heatmap](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/data/activity-heatmap): A liquid glass streak calendar for habit, fitness, study and journaling apps: weeks of days drawn in one Canvas as rounded cells in solid steps from a pale red mix up to pure red, laid out by the locale's first weekday with month labels on their week columns, a semibold streak numeral under a glass streak chip that stays alive until midnight beside the longest run and active days, a scrub that lifts the day under your finger as a tinted glass tile with a glass callout budding out of it on a liquid neck and a haptic tick per day, a glass legend chip, sideways scrolling that opens on today when the weeks outgrow the width, and VoiceOver that steps day by day or plays the weeks as an audio graph. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ActivityHeatmap`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ActivityHeatmap.json
- [Live Stat](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/data/live-stat): A liquid glass metric tile: a semibold display value that rolls with a spring and dims its decimals, a tinted delta chip, a sparkline you hold and scrub to retarget the value live while a glass flag buds out of the tile's top edge above your finger with the change from that point to the latest, a press that expands the line into a taller chart with low and high, and a tinted block variant. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add LiveStat`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/LiveStat.json
- [Odometer](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/data/odometer): A number whose digits roll on individual slots like a mechanical counter, carrying from the low digits up so unchanged digits never move, with softened slot edges while rolling, dimmed decimals, a separate sign, a dashed loading state, and a tinted liquid glass delta chip that buds out from behind the figure after each change, rests joined beside it and melts back in. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add Odometer`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/Odometer.json
- [Ring Breakdown](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/data/ring-breakdown): A composition ring of solid color blocks with rounded seams that you scrub by dragging around it, with a haptic at each slice boundary and a radial lift for the selected slice while the rest step back to the surface, around a semibold center figure under a liquid glass label pill whose name morphs letter by letter and out of which the selected slice's share buds as a tinted chip, above a legend of glass chips resting apart that take the slice's tint when picked. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add RingBreakdown`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/RingBreakdown.json
- [Scrub Chart](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/data/scrub-chart): A liquid glass line or bar chart: a semibold readout with dimmed decimals beside a tinted glass delta chip, a glass flag that rides the scrub rule with the range's change budding out of it and resting joined while a range is held, hold-and-drag range selection, and a range picker of joined glass segments whose tint flows into the one you pick as it swells, morphing the line between datasets. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ScrubChart`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ScrubChart.json

## Feedback (https://swiftpieces.com/components/feedback)

- [Outcome Screen](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/feedback/outcome-screen): A success, failure or empty outcome view sharing one choreography, where a ring draws, floods into a solid color block, the mark strokes in dark ink, one pulse lands with a haptic, and the headline and a signal-tinted liquid glass action rise. On failure an async retry morphs the action's label to "Retrying" while a progress bubble buds out of its end on a liquid neck, and a glass details block opens to the technical text. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add OutcomeScreen`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/OutcomeScreen.json
- [Rating Scrub](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/feedback/rating-scrub): A star rating you tap or scrub, with soft rounded stars that fill as solid blocks colored by the score and rise under your finger like soft keys, falling back in a ripple when you let go, with a little give past either end. While you scrub, a glass readout tinted with the score buds up out of the touched star and rides from star to star, and the caption under the stars is a glass numeral pill joined to a tinted label chip whose word morphs letter by letter. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add RatingScrub`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/RatingScrub.json
- [Reaction Toggle](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/feedback/reaction-toggle): A liquid glass like or save toggle. It presses in, its glass capsule floods with its tint from the symbol outward while the symbol swaps to its filled form and squashes and springs like soft rubber, the count rolls, and a confirmation pill buds out of the capsule on a liquid neck and melts back into it. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ReactionToggle`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ReactionToggle.json
- [Skeleton Loader](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/feedback/skeleton-loader): Solid placeholder bones and a self-masking modifier that turns any layout, color blocks included, into one quiet shape sweeping a soft diagonal highlight on a shared clock, then hands off as content unblurs and rises row by row. The bones stand in for content, so they stay solid rather than glass. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add SkeletonLoader`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/SkeletonLoader.json
- [Status Morph](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/feedback/status-morph): One continuous stroke that spins as a loading arc, closes into a ring, floods into a solid block and draws a check in dark ink on success, or a cross with a nudge on failure, with an optional caption on a liquid glass pill under the ring whose label morphs letter by letter. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add StatusMorph`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/StatusMorph.json

## Glass (https://swiftpieces.com/components/glass)

- [Glass Action Menu](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/glass/glass-action-menu): A liquid glass action menu. Hold the signal trigger and its actions bud out of it along a line or an arc, each born inside it and pulling a neck that thins and snaps, with its name budding from its side; slide across them and release to fire. The others melt home first and the fired one last, as the trigger lands a check; a tap toggles and a scrim dismisses. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add GlassActionMenu`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/GlassActionMenu.json
- [Glass Mode Bar](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/glass/glass-mode-bar): One liquid glass body that turns into whatever mode you pick. At rest a capsule of mode icons spans the width; tap one and a signal anchor carrying that mode buds out of the capsule's leading end while the capsule draws back to make room and trades its icons for that mode's own controls, a waveform for voice, thumbnails for photos, chips for a timer. Tap the anchor and it melts home as the icons come back. The body keeps its footprint the whole time. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add GlassModeBar`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/GlassModeBar.json
- [Glass Quick Add](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/glass/glass-quick-add): A liquid glass Quick add pill that folds up into a card. Tap it and the pill grows up and across into a menu of capture kinds; pick one and the same glass re-forms in place into that capture, a title field and its option chips. A signal Save bubble buds out from under the card's corner only once there is something to save, melts back if the field empties, and saving folds the whole thing down into the pill. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add GlassQuickAdd`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/GlassQuickAdd.json
- [Glass Segments](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/glass/glass-segments): A liquid glass segmented control: a signal-tinted glass indicator melted into a glass track as one surface. It moves like liquid, its leading edge reaching the new segment first and the trailing edge following, so it stretches across and gathers in. Grab it to scrub: it lifts under the finger, flattens against the ends and lands where the flick was heading, while the label ink flips exactly under its edge; tap still works. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add GlassSegments`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/GlassSegments.json
- [Glass Surface](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/glass/glass-surface): The public face of the SwiftPieces liquid glass: `.glassSurface` draws any view on a liquid glass capsule, rect, circle or concentric shape, and `GlassSurface.Group` melts neighbouring surfaces into one through a liquid neck. Liquid Glass on iOS 26; before it a frosted surface with its own press, top light and specular edge; a solid fill under Reduce Transparency, and a designed disabled state everywhere. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add GlassSurface`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/GlassSurface.json

## Inputs (https://swiftpieces.com/components/inputs)

- [Address Field](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/address-field): A liquid glass address field for checkout, delivery and sign-up. Type-ahead suggestions pour down out of the field as a glass list with the matched text picked out, a clear or searching bubble buds from the field's end, and picking a row with a tap or the hardware keyboard buds a spinner bubble beside it while it resolves into a structured address with street, city, state, postal code, country and coordinate; the list then melts back into the field as the address settles in with the locality on a second line and a sage check, keeping the typed text usable with a "Use as typed" row and a butter retry bubble when a lookup fails. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add AddressField`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/AddressField.json
- [Amount Field](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/amount-field): A currency amount entry that formats live in the user's locale as each digit lands (grouping, decimal separator, symbol before or after, the currency's own fraction digits), with a large auto-fitting semibold figure whose digits roll in, a blinking signal caret right after the digits, robust paste of amounts like "$1,234.56" or "1 234,56 €", and a limit that refuses the keystroke with a damped shake, an error haptic and a butter glass pill with the limit, budding out of the compact field's liquid glass block, all backed by a `Decimal` binding. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add AmountField`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/AmountField.json
- [Date Range Picker](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/date-range-picker): A start-to-end date range picker on a paged month grid built from the environment calendar and locale, with the selection in liquid glass over the grid. A touch presses a small glass bubble into the day and the tap swells it into a red glass start bubble; the second tap lands the end the same way and the band pours out of the start along each week and into the end like liquid, joined to both bubbles by necks. Sold-out days are struck through, a refused end day swells into a butter bubble that shakes and melts away, a maximum length dims unreachable days, months page by swipe or a joined pair of glass chevrons that melt into each other at the ends, the month and summary morph letter by letter, and a glass chip reads out the dates and nights. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add DateRangePicker`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/DateRangePicker.json
- [Expanding Track](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/expanding-track): A thumbless liquid glass slider: a glass bar that swells from 8pt to a 32pt bar under the finger with a solid color fill inside, shows detent dots while dragging, buds a glass readout bubble up out of the bar that rides the held edge on a liquid neck and melts back in when you let go, squishes past either end, and can carry an uppercase label with a big numeral; a second init selects a range with two sinking handles. A clear bubble buds out of the field's end while you type, a character counter buds down out of it and turns butter at a grapheme-accurate limit, bumping when extra input is refused, and validation waits until you leave the field before drawing an error ring and budding a butter warning bubble with the message, an error haptic and a VoiceOver announcement, shakes the field once when Return or a form submit meets an error, and shows a quiet sage check once fixed. - [Location Picker](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/location-picker): A map picker for delivery, rides, events and listings: drag the map under a fixed red pin that lifts while the map moves and, when it settles, drops and presses into place with a light tap, the address under it is looked up after a short pause with stale answers cancelled and recent ones cached. The chrome over the map is liquid glass: a floating glass card shows the street and locality, morphing letter by letter as it changes (a dropped pin with coordinates where there is no address, and a Retry bubble that pinches off its end when the lookup fails), the glass locate button asks for location only when tapped and flies to you, and the red Confirm capsule buds down out of the card once the spot has its answer and melts back into it while the map moves. - [Range Slider](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/range-slider): A liquid glass dual-thumb slider: two glass bubble thumbs joined by a tinted glass span over a quiet line, with a glass readout chip joined above each thumb on a liquid neck; drag either thumb or touch the track to pull the nearest one over, the thumbs stay under the finger and land on their step when you let go, values snap to a step without floating drift, the thumbs never cross and keep a minimum gap, a thumb pulled past the end of the track gives with rubber-band resistance and springs back, a grabbed thumb swells and its chip takes the span's tint, as the thumbs meet one chip melts into the other to read as one range, and every step ticks a selection haptic with a firmer impact at a bound or the gap. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add RangeSlider`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/RangeSlider.json

Tap, hold to repeat with acceleration, or scrub sideways across the pill for velocity-scaled steps while a ruler slides under the finger; at a bound that button melts into the pill and the pill strains against the stop, and the button buds back out the moment it can be used. ## Lists (https://swiftpieces.com/components/lists)

- [Depth Carousel](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/depth-carousel): Paged cards that recede in depth as they leave center and hand each page a phase value for inner parallax. A held neighbor starts forward and comes to center on tap. Underneath, a glass page counter joined by a liquid neck to a scrubbable glass track, whose tinted glass pill stretches between the dots as the pages move, flattens against the ends and follows the finger when scrubbed, computed in absolute page coordinates so it never jumps. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add DepthCarousel`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/DepthCarousel.json
- [Drag Select Grid](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/drag-select-grid): A multi-select photo and file grid where one drag paints a whole reading-order range the way the system photo library does, a sideways drag or a short hold starts painting while vertical swipes still scroll, dragging back unpaints, starting on a selected item deselects, the grid auto-scrolls faster the deeper the finger sits in the top or bottom edge, and selected cells inset under a liquid glass badge that buds out of the print's corner, floods signal red as the check stamps down and melts back into the corner, with a haptic tick per item. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add DragSelectGrid`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/DragSelectGrid.json
- [Follow Scroll](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/follow-scroll): A chat, log and live-feed scroll container that opens on the newest item and stays pinned to it while the reader is at the bottom, but never yanks them away once they scroll up to read; items that arrive below are counted into a liquid glass pill that buds up out of the bottom edge on a neck, jumps back to the latest and melts back down into the edge once the reader is caught up, older items loaded at the top keep the visible row exactly where it was while a glass spinner buds down from the top edge, and keyboard, rotation, growing rows and removals all hold the reader's place. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add FollowScroll`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/FollowScroll.json
- [Paged List](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/paged-list): An async/await infinite-scroll list that prefetches the next page a few rows before the end, never runs two loads at once, drops duplicate ids across pages, ignores stale responses after a refresh or cancel, and shows pulsing skeleton rows; its footer is one liquid glass bubble that spins while a page loads, widens into a "Couldn't load more" pill with a Retry bubble budding out of it on a liquid neck that keeps loaded rows, and becomes a quiet "You're all caught up" pill at the end, with pull to refresh that replaces rows only on success. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add PagedList`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/PagedList.json
- [Status Timeline](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/status-timeline): A vertical status timeline on liquid glass nodes: the live node is tinted and breathes, completed ones stamp to a tinted check as the ink runs down the line to the next stop, and a step's detail buds out of its node as a glass panel joined to it, melting back in as the relay moves on. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add StatusTimeline`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/StatusTimeline.json
- [Swipe Action Row](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/swipe-action-row): Wraps any row in a liquid glass card whose swipe actions are tinted glass bubbles. As the card slides they bud out of its edge, joined to it and to each other by liquid necks, and melt back in as it closes; the card lands in its detent at the speed you let go, a full swipe clicks in with a haptic as the edge bubble swallows the others and takes the bar, a destructive one carries the card out of the row, and a shared binding keeps one row open at a time. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add SwipeActionRow`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/SwipeActionRow.json
- [Task Row](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/task-row): A task card with liquid glass chrome. Its check is a glass bubble, stamped in ink and popping as the check draws while the card flashes into a solid block, then settling to tinted glass as the row compacts; the priority sits on a tinted glass chip; a swipe-right buds a complete bubble out from under the card that completes with a strike-through; a swipe-left buds Snooze and Delete bubbles that part to rest apart; and a long-press lift reports reorder moves. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add TaskRow`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/TaskRow.json

- [Permission Sheet](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/sheets/permission-sheet): A pre-permission sheet that previews what it brings as a fanned stack of notification banners, each a tinted app tile, a line and now, that drop in one after another and deal the next to the front while it waits. A centred title and message sit under it, the request is a signal glass capsule whose label morphs through Requesting to Allowed as the stack pops and Not now melts into it, and a denial greys the stack out, swaps the copy and routes the button to Settings. - [Spotlight Tour](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/sheets/spotlight-tour): A first-run feature tour for any screen: mark controls with .spotlightAnchor and .spotlightTour dims everything else through a cutout that springs from stop to stop as a red ring draws around it, and sets a liquid glass callout with step progress below or above the target inside the safe area, its glass nub pointing at it. Skip and a red Next are a liquid glass pair that bud out of the callout on the far side from the target; on the last stop Skip melts into Next as Next morphs to Done. Taps reach the real control (which can also advance the tour), stops that aren't on screen are skipped, the cutout follows its target through scrolling, rotation and the keyboard, the tour can show itself only once, and VoiceOver, hardware keyboards and Reduce Motion stay in step. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add SpotlightTour`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/SpotlightTour.json
- [Toast](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/sheets/toast): A single liquid glass toast. Placed inside the safe area so it clears the Dynamic Island and rides above the keyboard. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add Toast`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/Toast.json

(iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add GlassText`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/GlassText.json
- [Picture Headline](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/text/picture-headline): A semibold headline with living pictures stuck between its words like a hand-placed collage. Each word rises into place and each picture opens from a dot into a tilted sticker with a white rim, landing with a spring, a light tick and a flash of crop marks, then keeps drifting. Press a sticker to lift it. Use the built-in house-palette scenes (the sun is our red mascot), your own images or SF Symbols; it wraps like text at any width and Dynamic Type size. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add PictureHeadline`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/PictureHeadline.json
